title: Choice of a good cutting level: Helly no-concentration, Fatou-bounded slice values and a.e. good slices at one common level
statement: Let ν_j (j ∈ ℕ) be measures on the Borel sets of ℝ and let F_j : ℝ → [0, ∞] (j ∈ ℕ) be functions, each a.e.-measurable for Lebesgue measure L¹. Let Good_j (j ∈ ℕ) be predicates on ℝ (Good : ℕ → ℝ → Prop), let a < b be reals and let Λ ∈ [0, ∞). Assume that for every j: ν_j([a, b]) ≤ Λ, ∫_ℝ F_j dL¹ ≤ Λ (lower Lebesgue integral), and Good_j(t) holds for L¹-a.e. t ∈ ℝ. Then there are s ∈ (a, b), a strictly increasing φ : ℕ → ℕ and C ∈ [0, ∞) with the following properties: Good_j(s) holds for every j ∈ ℕ; F_{φ(j)}(s) ≤ C for every j ∈ ℕ; and for every ε ∈ (0, ∞] there is δ > 0 with ν_{φ(j)}([s − δ, s]) ≤ ε for all sufficiently large j.
lean_statement: ∀ (ν : ℕ → Measure ℝ) (F : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ≥0∞) (Good : ℕ → ℝ → Prop) (a b : ℝ) (Λ : ℝ≥0∞), a < b → Λ ≠ ∞ → (∀ j, ν j (Icc a b) ≤ Λ) → (∀ j, AEMeasurable (F j)) → (∀ j, ∫⁻ t, F j t ≤ Λ) → (∀ j, ∀ᵐ t, Good j t) → ∃ s ∈ Ioo a b, ∃ (φ : ℕ → ℕ) (C : ℝ≥0∞), StrictMono φ ∧ C ≠ ∞ ∧ (∀ j, Good j s) ∧ (∀ j, F (φ j) s ≤ C) ∧ ∀ ε : ℝ≥0∞, 0 < ε → ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ ∀ᶠ j in atTop, ν (φ j) (Icc (s - δ) s) ≤ ε
